name: Cloud provider CLIs
description: Pinned gcloud, AWS CLI v2, Azure CLI and PowerShell. Sole owner of these version pins; composable on any stack (e.g. terraform-tools + cloud-tools for GCP roots). Never mount host cloud config read-write — use read-only mounts or container-local config dirs.

aws.description: AWS CLI v2 version (versioned zip, .sig verified); 'none' skips.

az.description: Azure CLI version (standalone GitHub-release tarball); 'none' skips.

gcloud.description: Google Cloud SDK version (apt-only upstream; pinned via an apt-cache madison soft-match). 'none' skips.
